title: ISO/IEC 27017:2026 cloud-control evidence pilot
disclaimer: Non-scoring local evidence profile; no ISO conformity, certification or legal-compliance conclusion.

aspects.principle: Shared roles and responsibilities within a cloud computing environment
aspects.subject: Allocation and operating effectiveness of cloud security responsibilities
aspects.scope: Each material cloud service, lifecycle stage and security activity in the approved assessment boundary
aspects.prohibitedInference: A responsibility matrix alone proves operating effectiveness.

aspects.principle: Agreement on the roles and responsibilities of the cloud service partner
aspects.subject: Contractual agreement and lifecycle governance with cloud service partners
aspects.scope: Each material provider, broker, integrator and subprocessor in the approved assessment boundary
aspects.prohibitedInference: A provider certification transfers accountability to the provider.

aspects.subject: Effective isolation of tenants, trust zones, workloads and lifecycle environments
aspects.scope: Virtual compute, identity, network, secrets and key boundaries in each approved target environment
aspects.prohibitedInference: Presence of namespaces, VNETs or accounts proves effective isolation.

aspects.principle: Detection and prevention of unauthorized use of cloud services
aspects.subject: Discovery, authorization and response coverage for cloud, SaaS and cloud-hosted AI use
aspects.scope: Identity, network, endpoint, expense and procurement telemetry explicitly approved for the assessment
aspects.prohibitedInference: No detection alert proves that unauthorized cloud use is absent.
